snippet.title: One year of indie game dev and design - Blade Blitz Devlog
snippet.description:
It's been a little over a years worth of work on my indie game, Blade Blitz. It's started from a prototype, through numerous iterations, and now it's all coming together. If it looks interesting to you, visit the Steam page and give it a wishlist.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/3161450/Blade_Blitz/
